reviewItem.question: Does "Removal of insecure configuration for exceptions: In prior versions, policy exceptions were allowed in all namespaces" mean a change to crd-field:kyverno|group=kyverno.io|kind=PolicyException|path=spec (behavior-changed)?

change.after: "policy exceptions disabled by default; only allowed in a specified namespace"

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes its defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and may only be created in a specified namespace (previously allowed in all namespaces, CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on PolicyExceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to keep them working.
